desc:
Available on console, PC and mobile ( 🎮📱💻 )
Like and Favorite for more updates!

Controls
G - Ultimate
F - Block
Q + WASD - Dash
Uppercut Look Up + Dash - Air Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - Run
Left Click - M1
B - Emote Wheel
Q + Right click - Slide 
Q + Right click + Jump - Air Jump
Dash + Dash - Slide (Mobile + Console)
Dash + Dash - Jump (Mobile + Console)
Huge Thanks To Vol3an For Making this Possible
